narration: Chat Relay puts every Claude Code node in your cluster at your fingertips — one browser tab, any machine, any project, from anywhere in the world.
This dropdown lists every Jarvis node in your cluster — Alpha, Bravo, Charlie, or the cloud VPS. Pick one and every prompt routes directly to that machine.
Set a timeout that matches the work — one minute for quick questions, up to ten for deep refactors.
Type any prompt you would normally write at the terminal. Control-Enter dispatches it to the selected node.
Results come back as expandable message cards — stdout, stderr, exit code, and elapsed time all visible at a glance.
The node status indicators show live cluster health in real time — green means that machine is reachable and ready right now.
No SSH client, no VPN, no terminal emulator — just your browser and the full power of Claude Code running on your own hardware.
